items.title: 28% increase in passports issued by the Italian Consulate in Dubai
items.description: (ANSA) - ROMA, 28 LUG - The Consulate General of Italy in Dubai reports that in the first six months of 2026, it issued 1,340 passports, compared to 1,046 during the same period in 2025. This represents a 28% increase. “This increase,” explains the consulate, “did not occur in spite of the conflict, but rather because of the conflict.” Furthermore, the consular offices remained open throughout March to renew expiring passports and issue first passports to newborns. Read article...

items.title: Italy 'books' SAFE loan of up to €14.9 billion, but EC says deal must be signed ASAP
items.description: (ANSA) - ROME, JUL 28 - Deputy Premier and Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani said Tuesday that the government has reserved the right to take a loan from the EU's SAFE (Security Action for Europe) facility of up to 14.9 billion euros to invest in security and defence. Tajani stressed that the loan only has been "reserved" and that the government will decide by the end of the year how much actually to take, if any, as he reported to a joint session of the defence and foreign affairs committees of the Lower House and Senate over the recent NATO summit in Ankara. Economy Minister Giancarlo Giorgetti
items.titleIt: Italy 'books' SAFE loan of up to €14.9 billion, but EC says deal must be signed ASAP

items.title: Govt cuts diesel duties by 17 cents to help with rise in fuel costs
items.description: (ANSA) - ROME, JUL 28 - A 17-cent cut in diesel duties that the government approved on Monday to help people cope with high fuel costs following the return of conflict in the Persian Gulf came into effect on Tuesday and will remain in place until August 6. The cut will cost the State around 125 million euro and should bring diesel prices in line with those for unleaded petrol, the duties of which have not been reduced. Premier Giorgia Meloni described the cut as "a timely, responsible response" to the recent increase in fuel prices. The government has not ruled out further measures. (ANSA). Re
items.titleIt: Govt cuts diesel duties by 17 cents to help with rise in fuel costs

items.title: Sudan: Heavy Rains and Floods Worsen Suffering of Displaced Persons in Blue Nile State
items.description: [Darfur Network for Human Rights] Damazin city and several areas across Blue Nile State are facing a worsening humanitarian situation. Heavy rainfall and flooding continue to deepen the suffering of thousands of displaced persons living in shelters and displacement camps, compounding an already fragile situation shaped by ongoing armed conflict and a weak humanitarian response.
